verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official CLI. It is documented at firebase.google.com/docs/cli, and the firebase-tools GitHub repo lists deploying code and assets, running a local Hosting server, working with database data, and importing/exporting Auth users. Functions docs also confirm one-command deploys from the command line. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly CLI behavior (machine-readable output, non-interactive or CI auth), an explicit tie between the CLI and the AI tooling such as the MCP server, and independent hands-on corroboration of AI-native CLI use.
